text:
harper.partnerships: Kicking off a coordination thread for a combined marketplace + SI packaged launch: Redwood DeltaSync Bridge (Snowflake DeltaShare -> Databricks notebooks + Qdrant/Milvus adapters). Proposed announce: Mon Aug 3 09:00 PT. Need owners for each lane; reply with :white_check_mark: on what you own.

harper.partnerships: High-level checklist:
- compatibility & perf validation (eng)
- docs + Databricks notebooks (docs)
- marketplace tile + assets (gtm)
- partner legal approvals & embargo (legal)
- staging demo environment & runbook (infra)

leo.engineering: I'll take eng perf + compatibility. Planning 40M ingest runs across Qdrant and Milvus backends to get p95 numbers. Also will validate DeltaShare cross-account role flow and nested VARIANT handling.

harper.partnerships: Thanks @leo.engineering. Can you paste the ingest command you'll run and artifact path so docs/marketing can grab screenshots?

leo.engineering: Ingest command (staging):
```
redwood ingest --connector deltasync-bridge \
  --source delta://acct/db/schema/table \n  --sink qdrant://staging-qdrant:6333 \n  --shards 10 \n  --quantize int8 \n  --batch 2000 \n  --output s3://redwood-artifacts/deltasync-40m-2026-08-01.tar.gz
```
I'll post p95 ingest/query numbers and perf dashboard link here when done.

jasmin.docs: I'll own docs + Databricks notebook examples (PySpark and SQL flow). Need the recommended embeddings model and CLI snippets. Also planning a "decision matrix" doc: when to livestream from DeltaShare vs export to vector DB.

ryan.gtm: I'll take marketplace tile + screenshots + launch email. Need perf dashboard image + a short 1-line benefit statement. Also coordinating co-marketing copy with Snowflake and Qdrant legal teams.

marie.legal: Legal here 1 we need partner logo approvals (SVG + usage notes) and embargo agreement by Fri 16:00 PT. Also confirm that we won't reference partner internal beta customers in the blurb without signed releases.

staging-bot: Demo environment provisioned: staging-deltasync-2026-07-30 (owner: leo.engineering)

leo.engineering: Quick note re: nested VARIANT->ARRAY mapping: connector currently flattens top-level arrays but misses deeply nested arrays. I'll push a small normalize step PR; target Mon morning. Without it some Delta shapes will fail ingest.

harper.partnerships: If PR slips we'll consider a limited scope for launch that calls out "supported column types" and follow with a patch release. Either way tag the PR here.

leo.engineering: PR opened: GH#4510 - add deep-normalize to deltasync extractor. I'll tag it and link tests.

jasmin.docs: Draft quickstart CLI snippet for docs:
```
# one-off export from DeltaShare to vector DB via DeltaSync Bridge
redwood connector create --type deltasync --name delta-bridge-1 \
  --source delta://acct/db/schema/table \
  --sink qdrant://prod-qdrant:6333 \
  --options quantize=int8,batch=2000
redwood connector run --name delta-bridge-1 --once
```
Can we confirm recommended batch size for 768-dim embeddings?

leo.engineering: Recommend 1500-2500 depending on VM type; will include a recommended table in docs after perf. For staging 2000 was stable.

ryan.gtm: Marketplace headline draft: "DeltaSync Bridge: Seamless DeltaShare exports to Databricks notebooks and top vector DBs." Shorter headline: "DeltaSync Bridge for Snowflake 1 export or serve vectors." Thoughts?

harper.partnerships: Love the messaging. Keep short headline + 1-line benefit: "Export vectors from Delta tables into Qdrant or Milvus, or serve them live via Databricks. Fast setup, predictable throughput."

marie.legal: Also request from Qdrant: their legal team wants a specific attribution line in co-marketing: "Qdrant is a supported vector database." We'll get their brand kit. Please upload logos to the evidence folder.

ci-bot: CI: release candidate rc-deltasync-bridge-2026-07-31 created (pipeline #5021) - integration tests queued.

leo.engineering: Perf run complete (40M vectors, 10 shards, int8): ingest throughput 26k vec/s, p95 ingest 410ms, query p95 ~32ms for 768-dim vectors. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/deltasync-40m-2026-08-01.tar.gz. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/deltasync/40m (staging access).

jasmin.docs: Grabbing the dashboard screenshot now. Adding a Databricks notebook cell to install redwood-client wheel during cluster init. Will attach sample notebook Gist in a min.

ryan.gtm: Captured perf + console screenshots. Ryan to coordinate with design for final assets. ETA Wed EOD.

marie.legal: Received assets for review. Noted one instance where partner logos were incorrectly scaled. Please follow brand kit instructions. Also, embargo memo sent to partner contacts; awaiting confirmation.

leo.engineering: Small compatibility note: live-serving via DeltaShare has a caveat with long-running transactions — recommend using snapshot isolation for consistent reads. Will add to docs and runbook.

harper.partnerships: Good call. Jasmin, add a short "known limitations" section in the quickstart and link the PR.

jasmin.docs: Done - added "known limitations" and the snapshot isolation recommendation. Also added a troubleshooting matrix for VARIANT mappings. Linking gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/deltasync-notebook (WIP).

ryan.gtm: Marketing assets ready pending legal sign-off. Draft launch email scheduled for Mon 09:00 PT (subject line draft in #marketing). Will hold send until legal clears embargo.

ci-bot: Integration tests passed for rc-deltasync-bridge-2026-07-31 - all green.

marie.legal: Partners confirmed embargo & logos cleared (Snowflake + Qdrant + Milvus). Legal sign-off complete.

harper.partnerships: Fantastic. Locking announce Mon Aug 3 09:00 PT. Final preflight for tomorrow:
- leo.engineering: confirm final perf artifact link & provide final dashboard screenshot (due EOD today)
- jasmin.docs: finalize notebooks + quickstart (due EOD today)
- ryan.gtm: finalize marketplace tile + email draft (due EOD today)
- marie.legal: confirm partner co-marketing line (done)

leo.engineering: Confirmed artifacts link above and dashboard screenshot uploaded to /assets/marketplace/deltasync/40m-dashboard.png

jasmin.docs: Notebooks pushed to docs branch and gists linked in thread.

ryan.gtm: Marketplace tile submitted to design and partner ops for last check. Email ready to send on lock.

harper.partnerships: Thanks everyone 1 this thread is canonical for launch coordination. Ping me immediately if anything comes up. :rocket:
